lines.en: All this weight makes heavy walking.
Shoulders first, then the legs.
I climb the grassy slope.
My horn tips brush the shrubs.

lines.zh: 雪原的风吹不透这层毛。
lines.en: Snowfield wind can't get through this coat.
One step flattens a clump of grass.
Hooves knock on frozen ground.
I walk the herd's edge.
A quick graze first.
I turn my body to block the wind.
Walk slow, walk steady.
Snow settles on my back.
I don't like being driven.
Each hoofprint deeper than the last.
I stand and chew my cud.
A tail flick chases the flies.
Wind lays my coat to one side.
A bison calls far off.
My eyes are half shut.
Snow on my horns doesn't melt.
I shift my stance slowly.
The grass roots taste good.
When I'm still, the grass is quiet.
You're standing downwind of me.
My horn is thicker than your arm.
Don't come at me from the front.
I smell iron on your hands.
You're not one of the herd.
I still carry snow on my back.
Touch my back, not my horns.
I walk my way; don't block me.
People always want to ride me.
I let out a low grunt.
My coat took some of it.
I shake my head.

lines.zh: 厚皮挨了一下，角还抬着。
lines.en: My thick hide took the blow, and my horns are still raised.
I turn to shield my ribs.
My hoof scrapes the ground.
I don't like being struck from behind.
Blood drips on the snow.
Push again and I charge.
I know the smell of apples.
I'll walk over slowly.
Not enough for me to chew.
I like sweet things.
Put the rod down.
Smells ripe to me.

lines.zh: 苹果钓竿举稳，我就低头。
lines.en: Hold the apple rod steady and I will lower my head.

lines.zh: 拿苹果钓竿？你倒是懂我。
lines.en: An apple on a rod? You know me well.
You hit me like a tree.
This body isn't meant to be pushed.
My hooves make the ground ring.
You took two steps back.
Don't press against my flank.
I'll just turn.
Snow got kicked up.
I dislike being crowded.
The herd has its own rules.
The season's still early.
These horns are for contesting.

lines.zh: 我的角尖擦过矮树，你别站那。
lines.en: My horn tips scrape the brush; do not stand there.
First, let's see who's stronger.
Don't block my path.
I don't do that with people.
My mate is in the herd.
Walk away.
I still have grass to eat.
This fell on the ground.
I nudge it with my nose.
Not grass; I won't eat it.
Hard, like a horn.
This could wear down my horn.
I sniff it; unfamiliar.
Leave it.
Don't let it wedge under my hoof.
I stepped over it.
You've entered my space.
I'm guarding the herd behind me.
One warning first.
My hoof paws the ground twice.
One move from you and I charge.
I can charge from this angle.
You're standing somewhere risky.
My breathing got heavy.
Don't make me mean it.
Once I charge I can't stop.
I've picked you.
My shoulder is harder than you think.
Step back.
Last chance.
Coming.
I close in step by step.
I'm in no rush to charge.
You're retreating.
I turn my head to follow you.
The snow packs under my hooves.
I'm watching your knees.
Turn and you show your back.
This is the right distance to charge.
I drop my weight lower.
You're panting; I'm not.
There's no cover on this snowfield.
You're backed against the fence.
I'm waiting for you to slip.
I'll try coming around the side.
That shield won't stop a horn.
One more step back and I charge.
Now.
Once I move, I don't stop.
Stand firm.
Charge!
A horn catches your hip.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀撞碎了你身后的栅栏。
lines.en: My shoulder smashed the fence behind you.
You were thrown two blocks.
My hoof stamps beside your foot.

lines.zh: 雪原的野牛，角比脚还沉。
lines.en: A snowfield bison whose horns weigh more than its feet.
After the charge I trample.

lines.zh: 你的护甲裂了，我这对角可没钝。
lines.en: Your armor cracked, and my horns are not dull.
My horn tip raked your shoulder.
Don't stand directly in front of me.
I'll back off and charge again.
I pushed the wind aside.
There's a crater in the snow.
I used my full strength.
Not done yet.
Again.
Hold your ground.
My patience lasts longer than you think.

lines.zh: 雪原的冲撞，蹄下不留活物。
lines.en: A snowfield charge leaves nothing alive under my hooves.
I lift my head on the plains.
Thick grass underfoot.
The herd is in the distance.
A couple of mouthfuls first.
Snow is in the wind.
I shake the snow off my back.
This pasture is good.
I walk slowly forward.
Grass clings to my horns.
I find a sheltered spot.
There's a fence far off.
This coat is warm enough.
Time to graze.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下去，滚了几圈。
lines.en: I fell down the slope and rolled.

lines.zh: 水没到我背，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: Water reached my back; I kicked hard.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我肩上的厚皮。
lines.en: Something stuck in my shoulder's thick hide.

lines.zh: 那股力气钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: That force crawled into my bones.
Hunger turns my legs weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我浑身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back; I jolted all over.
The ground is gone.
